correctness.rationale: Semisimple module classification fixes every exterior subalgebra as V_S+F(h+u). Ideal/ideal pairs always permute; mixed pairs are counted by the subspace graph lemma H_q; the exterior/exterior criterion is equality of residual cosets since no constituent admits an invariant line. The 2^r-by-2^r exterior pair sum factors as product_i(1+3q^{d_i}). Dominant exponents give asymptotic 1 for d>=5 and exact expanded d=4 gives 1/4. The embedded direct Lie-bracket checker passes five complete prime-field instances. Finite tests are only supporting evidence.
